assumptions: Explicit complete decode events; no cycle extrapolation or skipped tokens.
Warmup and measurement are complete-event windows; startup PD imports are separate.
Callbacks own shared resource calendars and prepared-KV capacity; admission requires ready time.
Every request and prepared successor owns a stable slot_id; replacement never migrates KV by changing positions in the active list.

PD admission, issue and whole-import completion bytes are separate. PEC uses completed program bytes, with unfinished start/end imports corrected by byte conservation; individual sub-program completion times remain callback-specific.
Service occupancies can overlap and must not be added to infer wall-clock time.
Mean request TPOT excludes its own PD admission delay; mean_iteration_ns includes all admission stalls and is the full-batch runtime/SLO comparison metric.

Completed-request residence measures fresh admission through last decode output, including intervening stalls; completions inside measurement may have begun in warmup. Staggered startup seeds are excluded. External prefill/PD-before-admission delay is not included.
Three-year PEC is physical programmed bytes / usable HBF bytes under ideal uniform wear; it is not measured erase counts, an FTL/GC prediction, or a NAND endurance guarantee.
Observed closed-loop window is not a proof of a periodic steady state.

validations.slo_statistic: mean_iteration: complete full-batch iteration including PD replacement waits

assumptions: Explicit complete decode events; no cycle extrapolation or skipped tokens.
Warmup and measurement are complete-event windows; startup PD imports are separate.
Callbacks own shared resource calendars and prepared-KV capacity; admission requires ready time.
Every request and prepared successor owns a stable slot_id; replacement never migrates KV by changing positions in the active list.

PD admission, issue and whole-import completion bytes are separate. PEC uses completed program bytes, with unfinished start/end imports corrected by byte conservation; individual sub-program completion times remain callback-specific.
Service occupancies can overlap and must not be added to infer wall-clock time.
Mean request TPOT excludes its own PD admission delay; mean_iteration_ns includes all admission stalls and is the full-batch runtime/SLO comparison metric.

Completed-request residence measures fresh admission through last decode output, including intervening stalls; completions inside measurement may have begun in warmup. Staggered startup seeds are excluded. External prefill/PD-before-admission delay is not included.
Three-year PEC is physical programmed bytes / usable HBF bytes under ideal uniform wear; it is not measured erase counts, an FTL/GC prediction, or a NAND endurance guarantee.
Observed closed-loop window is not a proof of a periodic steady state.

limitations: Paper calls this Llama3 405B; released Llama3.1 405B BF16 mp8 geometry is used explicitly.

precision.basis: Explicit BF16 research choice; not a dtype reported by the paper.

model.routing_basis: Uniform independent token routing, unique top-k within each token; expected distinct experts per batch.

model.parallelism_basis: Independent TP*EP*PP axes; dense/attention/shared replicated over EP; router/norm replicated over TP.
